function.name: create_form
function.description: Create a Google Forms test, quiz, survey, or questionnaire with the complete question list. Use this immediately when the teacher asks to create a test, quiz, контрольная, опрос, анкета, or Google Form, or confirms a previously drafted test. For a test or quiz set is_quiz=true. Do not return another draft instead of calling the tool. The tool always asks for explicit Telegram confirmation before creating anything. After confirmation the created form_id and responder link arrive in an action_result event.

is_quiz.description: Set true for a test, quiz, контрольная, or any form with correct answers, points, or automatic grading. Set false only for an ungraded survey/questionnaire.

questions.description: Complete list of questions to add to the form. For a test, include every generated question here.

type.description: radio/checkbox/dropdown require options; short_text/long_text are free-text answers.

options.description: Answer options. Required and non-empty for radio/checkbox/dropdown; must be omitted for text questions.

correct_answers.description: Correct answers for quiz mode. For choice questions each value must exactly match one of options.

points.description: Points for a correct answer. Optional when correct_answers is provided; defaults to 1.

required.description: Whether the respondent must answer this question.
